generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tender/contract includes maintenance items as detailed in the schedule B however, the agency has to quote LUMPSUM basis (Total Amount). The L1 price bid will be evaluated and percentage variation shall be considered to derive the schedule-B item rates proportionately. Final derived schedule-B items rates shall be reference for payment.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Performance Guarantee/ Security Deposit: The successful bidder shall furnish DD drawn in favor of General Manager (Finance) BTPS or e-Bank Guarantee obtained in the name of tender inviting authority towards performance guarantee / Security Deposit equivalent to 5% of the amount put to tender (estimated amt excluding GST) plus additional Security for unbalanced tender at the time of entering into contract agreement within 20 days from the date of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance of LOA/WO. The same shall be valid for the entire contract period plus 30 days from the date of end of Defect Liability Period. The additional Security unbalanced amount (difference of amount put to tender and quoted cost) shall be applicable for tenders which are quoted beyond 5% below the estimated cost (excluding GST).

technicalCriterionList.description: Work Experience: 1)The Bidder should have executed Mechanical Maintenance/Overhauling works of turbine and auxiliaries of 210 MW or above capacity coal fired thermal power plants as a prime contractor. The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above said work in a single contract for an amount not less than Rs. 116.66 Lakhs (excluding GST) in the preceding FIVE (05) financial years. 2) The intending bidder shall submit the work order and relevant work done certificate as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification. 3)Work done value for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order with Work Done Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: Financial Turnover: 1) The Bidder should have achieved a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs 466.66 lakhs (excluding GST) in any of the two of the preceding FIVE financial years. 2) The Bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. 3) Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.
